uzo.purpose: Groups content about one thing into a unit: a heading, optional image and text, and up to two actions.

instead.kialo: The fields of one record are names and values, because a person reads them as a list; that is the atributlisto.
What happened or what to watch for is a notice, because it tells a state in the flow; a card holds content.
A card is content, not a frame for the layout, because its heading names one thing; a box around other parts is the page's.

boundary.kialo: Nested controls inside a link are broken for the keyboard and the screen reader, because the link swallows the buttons and reads everything as its name; a person decides where the way to the detail goes.
The grid of many cards is a layout of the page, because columns and gaps depend on the view around them; it belongs to a Sxablono, and a person decides it until there is one.

containers.name: page-section
containers.kialo: Cards stand in a section of the page, because they summarise the things the section lists.

containers.name: dialog
containers.kialo: A dialog may show a card of what it asks about, because the decision needs the thing in sight.

with.kialo: The heading of a card is a titolo at the card's level, because it names the thing and is the name of the card for a screen reader.
The text of a card is running text, because it describes the thing in a sentence or two.
A status of the thing stands in the meta row as a badge, because a state is read at a glance.
A card offers at most two actions as buttons, because more turn the summary into a toolbar: at most one with emphasis high (one-primary-per-container).
A card may lead to the detail of its thing with a link in its actions, because the detail is a destination, not an action.
